description.value: One Stop Bakery is an Italian-inspired artisan bakery in Burnaby offering a broad range of freshly baked breads, donuts, pastries, cakes, cookies, and savoury items such as sausage rolls and croissants. The owner brings experience operating four bakeries in Rome, and all staff hail from Italy, giving the operation an authentic culinary focus. Touring cyclists can stock up on breads, buns, and ready-to-eat savoury baked goods, and the shop also offers online ordering for pre-planned stops.
